uci_credit.source_documentation: One row per credit-card client of a Taiwanese bank (2005): credit limit, demographics, six months (Apr-Sep 2005) of repayment status, bill statement and payment amounts. Treated here as a monthly client snapshot delivered by an upstream card system.

uci_bank_marketing.source_documentation: One row per telemarketing contact of a Portuguese bank (May 2008 - Nov 2010), ordered by date, with client attributes, contact attributes, previous-campaign attributes and national macro-economic indicators. Treated as a monthly delivery from a CRM/campaign system.

convention_notes.evidence: Documentation: missing values are coded 'unknown' (categorical) or 999 (pdays); no empty fields.
Documented category list in bank-additional-names.txt.
Plausible adult client ages; observed 17-98, 0 violations.
A duration in seconds is non-negative.
Documented: number of contacts in this campaign, includes the last contact.
A count is non-negative.
Days >= 0 or the documented sentinel 999.
poutcome is the outcome of the previous campaign, 'nonexistent' iff there was no previous contact; 0 violations.
A known number of days since a previous contact implies at least one previous contact; 0 violations.
Literal reading of the documentation (999 = not previously contacted) is contradicted by 4,110 untouched rows with previous > 0.

synthetic_balanced_journals.source_documentation: One row is a whole balanced journal within one currency. IDs are unique and required. Currency is USD or EUR. Amounts are nonnegative integer cents, not rounded display values. Total debits equal total credits exactly. No presentation blanks or missing-value sentinels exist. These are stipulated synthetic semantics, not independently verified accounting records.
synthetic_balanced_journals.sample_note: Entirely self-authored artificial examples, not bank/customer data.

statistical_unit_note: Three public source schemas and one synthetic scenario; repeated prompts are not independent domains.
